name_reason: Already compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, battle core table uses data_fd2_battle_*, _table suffix reflects array/lookup-table data type, and the descriptor (job_magic_resist) accurately names the per-job magic-resistance/scale content. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x51f96 or any data address). The trailing token is the domain word 'table', not an ID.
purpose: Read-only per-job magic-damage scale-factor lookup table; the defender's job determines how much spell power lands.
logic_summary: Sole consumer fd2_calc_magic_damage @ 0x1C75E bulk-copies all 28 dwords (REP MOVSD, ECX=0x1C) from 0x51F96 into a stack scratch buffer, then reads resist_value = stack[(bJob_id-1)] (stride 4, uint32 element, index = defender bJob_id - 1) and computes magic damage = (s32)(spell_base_power * resist_value) / 10. The value is the fraction of spell power taken, in tenths: 10 = full damage (no resist), lower = more resistant, so in-game magic resistance = (10 - value) * 10 percent. Cross-checked against fd2-knowledge job list: job 0x05 法師 -> 7 -> 30%, 0x0D 大法師 -> 5 -> 50%, 0x1A -> 4 -> 60%, all matching the guide's 魔抗 percentages.
element_semantics: uint32 magic-damage scale factor in tenths (4..10); element i corresponds to job_id (i+1). Indices 0..25 map to the 26 defined non-dragon jobs (job_id 0x01..0x1A); job 0x00 (the dragon) has no entry and is never looked up. Indices 26..27 are trailing dwords (values 10 and 7) that the REP MOVSD also copies but no defined job_id ever addresses.
comment_original_issue: Block comment and inline labels overstated the defined-job count: claimed 'Entries 0..26 map to the 27 jobs (job_id 1..27)' and labelled index 26 as '/* job 0x1b */', but the game has only 26 non-dragon jobs (0x01..0x1A); job 0x1b/0x1c do not exist. Also a stale '/* Non-const: ... seeded by test fixtures. */' line sat directly above a declaration that is actually 'const uint32[28]', contradicting the const-ness (no in-game writers => correctly const).
notes: Single reader fd2_calc_magic_damage (xrefs READ+DATA only) => truly read-only => const retained. Live Ghidra type is dword[28] and REP MOVSD count 0x1C both confirm 28 dwords, not the 27 in the datatype hint; src already declares [28]. Refined src block comment + inline label for index 26 (job 0x1b -> idx 26); removed contradictory Non-const line. Updated Ghidra plate to match (resist semantics + 26-defined-job extent). All values left byte-identical; no logic touched.
